get.bucket: A bucket. Fill it at the water.
get.knife: A mushroom knife. The brush cleans.
get.dyeBundle: The four flowers. Take them to the table.
get.splitWood: The branch, in two. Take it to the dirt.
get.stool: A stool. It does nothing. It looks nice.
get.lantern: A lantern. Put it where you like.
get.flowerPot: A pot with a flower. Put it where you like.

cut.title: Cut
cut.aimKeys: Z when the blade is between the marks
cut.aimTouch: Tap when the blade is between the marks
cut.sawTouch: Swipe side to side to saw
cut.tooHigh: Too high. Cut close to the ground.
cut.tooHighVolva: Too high. Keep the cup at the base.
cut.tooDeep: Too deep. That tears the mycelium.
cut.mycelium: Those white threads are the fungus itself: the mycelium. Left in the soil, it fruits again.

clean.title: Clean
clean.why: Brush, don't wash: mushrooms soak up water.

puffball.curiosity: Rain does the work: every drop that hits it puffs out spores.
puffball.cut: Cut under the ball, at the base.
puffball.clean: Brush off the soil and loose spines.
notes: Old ones puff out a cloud of spores.

inkCap.curiosity: Within hours it melts into black ink. People once wrote with it.
inkCap.cut: Cut low on the slim stem. It's hollow.
inkCap.clean: Be quick: once picked, it turns to ink within hours.
notes: It melts into black ink full of spores.
Pick it young. It inks within hours.

morel.curiosity: It favors dying elms and old apple orchards.
morel.cut: Cut at the base. The whole thing is hollow.
morel.clean: Grit hides in the pits. Brush each one.
notes: Spores grow in tiny sacs, not gills.

chanterelle.curiosity: It smells of apricots, and hardly any bug will eat it.
chanterelle.cut: Cut at the base, just above the moss.
chanterelle.clean: Dirt hides in the ridges. Brush them out.

flyAgaric.curiosity: It was once crumbled into milk to kill flies. Hence the name.
flyAgaric.cut: Cut below the soil line. The cup at the base, the volva, is how amanitas are told apart.
flyAgaric.clean: Brush gently: the white warts rub off.
notes: The warts are scraps of its egg-like veil.
The cup at the base marks an amanita.

porcini.curiosity: A single one can weigh over a kilo.
porcini.cut: Cut at the base of the thick stem.
porcini.clean: Brush the cap. White pores underneath mean it's young.

oyster.curiosity: It hunts: a drop of it stuns tiny worms, and it digests them.
oyster.cut: Cut the short stem, close to the bark.
oyster.clean: Brush out the leaf caught in the gills.
notes: Grows in shelves on dead wood, sideways.
Breaks the wood down and gives it back to the soil.

jackOLantern.curiosity: It glows in the dark: the gills light up a faint green.
jackOLantern.cut: Cut low, where the stems join.
jackOLantern.clean: Brush it, but never eat it.
notes: True gills, thin ones: the chanterelle has folds.
Looks like a chanterelle, but it's poison.

notebook.title: Field notebook
notebook.keys: Arrows turn the pages  ·  X close

entry.knife: A gift from Shui, with a brush on the handle. Cutting a mushroom instead of pulling it leaves whole what it has under the ground.
entry.axe: Marco's axe. It fells the dry tree and splits the stick on the chopping block.
entry.shovel: Sisi's shovel. It opens the holes in the cracked earth, where the dye seeds will live.
entry.bucket: A wooden bucket. Fill it with water; the water feeds what was planted and puts out fire.
entry.pickaxe: Thea's pickaxe. It breaks rock, and the rock gives stone, coal or ore, depending on the vein.
entry.scythe: The scythe Death left at the camp. It cuts tall grass. Death never came back for it.
entry.key: The key to the high garden. Whoever closes the valley's last request hands it over.
entry.wood: A stick from a dry tree. It becomes a bridge over water, stands up on Marco's block and, lit, becomes a torch.
entry.splitWood: The stick split in two on the block. Split wood dries faster and catches fire more easily.
entry.stone: A stone the pickaxe broke loose. In water it becomes a ford; on lava it cools into ground.
entry.charcoal: Coal, taken from the black vein by the lava. In the furnace it steals the oxygen from the ore and leaves the iron.
entry.ore: Iron ore: stone with iron trapped inside, as rust. On its own it is good for nothing.
entry.bloom: The iron bloom that comes out of the furnace: spongy iron, full of slag. It only becomes a bar by being hammered.
entry.iron: A real iron bar. From the ore to here: the coal, the furnace and the hammer.
entry.sand: Sand from the lake shore. It is almost all silica, the stuff glass is made of.
entry.ash: Ash from a fire. It has potash, which helps the sand melt in a cooler fire.
entry.glass: Glass of sand and ash, melted in Thea's furnace. Polished, it becomes a lens.
entry.dyeSeeds: Sisi's mixed seeds: four plants that give dye. Each one goes in a hole.
entry.dyeBundle: The four dye flowers, picked. The colours of Sisi's painting come from them.
entry.brush: Sisi's brush. With it, the painting on the easel gets the colours of the flowers.
entry.telescope: Thea's telescope, with the glass lens. From the top of the plateau it brings the stars closer.

moon.name: The Moon
moon.seen: Each bright spot is a crater. The dark ones are seas of old lava.
moon.fact: Its light takes 1.3 seconds to get here.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.seen: Four little dots in a row beside it. They are moons.
jupiter.fact: Galileo saw them in 1610: not everything circles the Earth.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.seen: The rings are not one piece.
saturn.fact: They are billions of bits of ice and rock, each on its own orbit.

pleiades.name: The Pleiades
pleiades.seen: To the naked eye, a smudge. Through the lens, dozens of stars.
pleiades.fact: That light left there some 440 years ago.

cut.keys: Press {Z} when the knife is between the marks, to cut.
cut.touch: Tap when the knife is between the marks, to cut.

clean.keys: Hold the mouse button and rub the sponge on the mushroom to clean it.
clean.touch: Drag the sponge over the mushroom to clean it.

aim.keys: Press {Z} when the aim is on the wood grain, away from the knot.
aim.touch: Tap when the aim is on the wood grain, away from the knot.

force.keys: Press {Z} when the strength is in the marked band.
force.touch: Tap when the strength is in the marked band.

strike.keys: Press {Z} several times to strike a spark.
strike.touch: Tap several times to strike a spark.

blow.keys: Press {Z} slowly, one breath at a time, so the ember catches.
blow.touch: Tap slowly, one breath at a time, so the ember catches.

lens.keys: Hold the mouse button and rub the lens to polish it (or press {Z}).
lens.touch: Rub the lens with your finger to polish it.

sky.keys: Use {←} {↑} {↓} {→} or drag the sky with the mouse to find the planets.
sky.touch: Drag the sky with your finger to find the planets.

paint.keys: Pick a paint ({1} to {4} or click a pot) and paint by dragging the mouse. {Enter} finishes.
paint.touch: Tap a pot and paint by dragging your finger.
